data.content:
Here's the complete implementation:

**Structure:**
```
TicketClassifier/
├── Data/tickets.csv              (training data)
├── Models/TicketData.cs          (ML.NET data classes)
├── Models/TicketRequest.cs       (API DTOs)
├── Services/TicketClassifierService.cs  (ML pipeline)
├── Program.cs                    (endpoints)
└── TicketClassifier.csproj       (+ Microsoft.ML 4.0.2)
```

**Endpoints:**
- `POST /api/tickets/classify` — predicts category with confidence scores
- `GET /api/tickets/metrics` — returns evaluation metrics (accuracy, log-loss)

**Test results:**
- Metrics: 100% micro/macro accuracy, log-loss 0.0002 (perfect fit on 6-row training set)
- `"Charged twice" + billing description` → **Billing** (73.8% confidence)
- `"App crashes" + technical description` → **Technical** (47.1% confidence)
- Validation rejects empty Subject/Description and out-of-range Priority

The model uses ML.NET's SDCA Maximum Entropy classifier with text featurization on Subject + Description and numeric Priority as features. For production, expand the training CSV — the small dataset demonstrates the full pipeline.
